propositions: 12 files are currently grandfathered over the 800 LOC module-size soft cap via allowlist and per-file ceiling exemptions, allowing them to persist and grow
The allowlist/ceilings escape-hatch mechanism must be removed entirely so no module can ever be exempted and the 800 LOC limit becomes absolute
Each grandfathered module must be refactored by splitting along a logical call-graph seam (never mechanically or creating <100-LOC files) and each split must land separately on main via Gerrit
The 800 LOC limit itself must be locked with a hard gate so it cannot be changed through the normal contribution process without admin manual override
After completion, no src/rebar/**/*.py file should exceed 800 LOC and the allowlist/ceilings files and sync contract test must be deleted
